hero.titleLine1: E nānā i ka hoʻohana ʻana.
hero.paragraph: Hāʻawi ʻo HydroLedger i nā kaiāulu hale noho i nā ʻike hoʻohana manawa maoli, ka uku ʻana i nā kumukūʻai like ʻole, a me nā ʻōlelo aʻo mua e pili ana i nā kulu wai — mai hoʻokahi papa kuhikuhi.

hero.panelSub: 8% ma lalo o ka awelika o ka hale

trustBar.label: Hoʻomalu ʻia e nā hui hoʻokele waiwai lehulehu holomua

features.headingPrefix: Nā mea a pau e pono ai e
features.paragraph: E hoʻokuʻu i nā kumukūʻai like ʻole. Hoʻoikaika ʻo HydroLedger i ke kaulike ma o ke ana pololei ʻana a me ka hana ʻakomi naʻauao.

items.tag: Ka Nānā ʻana i ka Wai
items.title: Ana Wai Manawa Maoli
items.text: E ana i ka hoʻohana wai pololei o kēlā me kēia minuke ma nā ʻāpana pākahi ma kahi o ka hilinaʻi ʻana i nā manaʻo kahiko.

items.title: Uku Kaiāulu ʻAkomi
items.text: Ka hana ʻana i ka invoice pololei i nā kamaʻāina e pili ana i ka hoʻohana ʻana. E hoʻopau koke i ka paʻakikī o ka uku ʻana.

items.title: Nā ʻŌlelo Aʻo No ke Kulu Wai
items.text: Hōʻike koke nā leka ʻakomi i nā ʻano kahe ʻano ʻē a loaʻa i ka pōʻino wai nui i loko o nā minuke, ʻaʻole i nā mahina.

items.title: Hoʻokaʻawale Kumukūʻai Pololei
items.text: E nānā i ka hoʻohana ʻana ma nā wahi kaʻana like a hoʻokaʻawale i nā kumukūʻai hale me ka maopopo e kūkulu i ka hilinaʻi o ka ʻohana.

howItWorks.heading: Hoʻokomo Maʻalahi, Hana Me ka Lima ʻOle
howItWorks.paragraph: E hoʻonohonoho koke. Ke hoʻopili ʻia nā lako, mālama ka paepae i nā helu paʻakikī, nā hoʻouna invoice, a me nā leka ʻōlelo no ke kulu wai.

steps.title: Hoʻopili i nā Mita Naʻauao
steps.text: Hoʻopili kā mākou poʻe ʻenehana i nā mita kahe naʻauao i nā kiwi riser pākahi ma lalo o 15 mau minuke.

steps.title: Nānā Manawa Maoli
steps.text: Holo mau ka ʻikepili i ka paepae kapua HydroLedger, e hoʻopaʻa i nā helu hoʻohana pololei a me ka nānā ʻana i nā hana ʻano ʻē.

steps.title: Uku ʻAkomi
steps.text: I ka hopena o ka mahina, hoʻohui ka ʻenekini i nā hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i nā wahi kaʻana like a me nā puke i ana ʻia i loko o nā invoice kikoʻī.

portalPreview.headingPrefix: E hāʻawi i ka mana i nā kamaʻāina me
portalPreview.paragraph: Kūkulu ka ʻike maopopo i ka lokahi o ke kaiāulu. Leʻaleʻa nā kamaʻāina i nā papa kuhikuhi maʻalahi me nā manaʻo manawa maoli, nā wānana kumukūʻai, a me nā ʻōlelo aʻo no ke kulu wai.
portalPreview.unitLabel: Unit 4B — Pōʻaiapuni Uku o kēia manawa
portalPreview.stat2Label: Ka nui o ka uku i manaʻo ʻia
portalPreview.tipText: Hōʻike kāu pā wai kīhini i ke kahe mau ʻana i ke kakahiaka. ʻO ka nānā ʻana i nā aerator hiki ke mālama i 10 galani/pule.

audienceSplit.residentHeading: Nā Kumukūʻai Wai Pololei e pili ana i ka Hoʻohana
audienceSplit.residentParagraph: E hoʻōki i ka uku ʻana no ka hoʻohana nui ʻana o kou hoalauna. E uku wale no nā galani āu e huki ai, me ka ʻikepili papa kuhikuhi manawa maoli.
residentBullets: ʻIkepili mita pololei o kēlā me kēia mahina me nā ana kumukūʻai akaka.
Nā leka SMS & kelepona inā ʻike ʻia nā kulu wai liʻiliʻi ma nā mīkini.
ʻŌnaehana uku invoice kikohoʻe maʻalahi me nā loaʻa ʻakomi.
audienceSplit.adminHeading: ROI Hana Koke a me ka Mana Hoʻopau
audienceSplit.adminParagraph: E hoʻololi i ka hoʻokele wai mai ka pilikia poho nui i ʻauwai loaʻa kālā kiʻekiʻe me ka uku ʻakomi o nā kamaʻāina.
adminBullets: Ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i ka wai i pili pono i nā ʻāpana pākahi.
Nā leka aʻo hana koke e pale aku ai i ka pōʻino wai hale kumukūʻai kiʻekiʻe.
Hōʻike papa kuhikuhi kikoʻī e pili ana i ka uku mita nui vs. nā galani i hoʻokaʻawale ʻia.

pricing.heading: Nā Kumukūʻai Hana ROI Kiʻekiʻe
pricing.paragraph: E koho i kahi hoʻolālā i hoʻololi ʻia i ka nui o kou kaiāulu. Hoʻopau pinepine ʻo HydroLedger i kāna mau uku paepae ponoʻī i ka mahina mua ma o ka hoʻemi ʻana i ka ʻōpala wahi kaʻana like.

testimonials.heading: Ka mea a nā Luna Waiwai e ʻōlelo nei

quotes.text: Ua hoʻololi kumu ʻo HydroLedger i kā mākou P&L hana. Ua ʻike mākou i ʻekolu mau kulu wai huna nui i loko o nā laina mīkini i mālama i kā mākou ʻoi aku ma mua o ₹11 lakh i kā mākou hapaha mua wale nō.

Ua piʻi aʻe ka hilinaʻi o nā kamaʻāina. ʻO ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana i kā mākou poʻe hoʻolimalima ma muli wale nō o ka hoʻohana ʻana i ka wai ma kahi o nā helu mita makuakāne maʻamau i hoʻoponopono i kā mākou hakakā hoʻolimalima ʻeha loa.

faq.heading: Nā Nīnau i Nīnau Pinepine ʻia

items.q: Pono anei nā mita liʻiliʻi naʻauao i ka pani ʻana i ka lawelawe mīkini?
items.a: ʻAʻole. Hoʻopili kā mākou mau mita riser hou ma luna pono o nā laina e kū nei i loko o nā crawlspaces pākahi. Pau ka hoʻonohonoho ʻana i loko o nā minuke me ka ʻole o ka ʻoki ʻana i nā pono lehulehu.

items.q: Pehea e helu ʻia ai nā kumukūʻai wai kaʻana like?
items.a: Hoʻemi ʻia ka wai ʻauʻau waena (e laʻa, nā hale ʻauʻau, nā ʻāina) mai nā mita nui mua. Hoʻokaʻawale nā hui waiwai i kēlā mau mea me ka maopopo.

items.q: Pehea ka wikiwiki o HydroLedger e ʻike ai i nā kahe kulu mau?
items.a: Nānā kā mākou mau ʻauwai leka aʻo i ka huki mau ʻana. Inā ʻaʻole hāʻule ke kahe i ka ʻole i loko o kahi pōʻaiapuni 10-minuke, hoʻouna koke ʻia nā leka aʻo e hoʻemi i nā pilikia pōʻino.

items.q: Mālama anei ʻo HydroLedger i ka palekana a i ʻole ka pilikino o nā kamaʻāina?
items.a: Ae. Mālama a mālama ʻo HydroLedger i nā mea ʻike portal kamaʻāina ma hope o nā kahawai i hoʻopili ʻia. Mālama ʻia ka ʻikepili hana no ka nānā ʻana i ka hoʻohana ʻana wale nō.

cta.pill: E hui pū me HydroLedger i kēia lā
cta.heading: E hoʻomaka i ka nānā ʻana i kāu hoʻohana wai i kēia lā
cta.paragraph: E hoʻonui i nā ana mālama, e hoʻomaʻalahi i ka uku o nā kamaʻāina, a e pale i ka ʻōnaehana hale koʻikoʻi. E ʻae iā mākou e helu i kāu manaʻo ROI kaiāulu.

footer.tagline: Nā ʻauwai hoʻokaʻawale pono naʻauao a me nā hoʻonā mita noho manawa maoli. Pale i nā ʻōnaehana, hoʻohālikelike i nā bila, mālama i ka wai.
